name: living-manual
description: Generate and maintain a branded, interactive user's manual from any codebase: clickable headings file notes that become developer tickets (optionally synced to Jira or GitHub Issues), roadmap previews show planned changes, a glossary explains concepts on first use, and reorder mode lets readers rearrange sections live and write the order back. Installs a push-time guard so the manual always reflects the released app.
